title: Hardship Settlement Offers on Time-Barred or Near-Expiry Debts
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Statute-of-Limitations Reductions

The statute-of-limitations expiry date on the Placed Consumer Accounts record bears on a Hardship Settlement offer under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements.

**Rule.** Where the account's statute-of-limitations expiry date is before the offer date, the Hardship Settlement time-barred reduction of 4.0 points applies; where that expiry date is on the offer date or within the 180 calendar days after it, the Hardship Settlement near-expiry reduction of 2.0 points applies; a later expiry date carries no statute reduction for a Hardship Settlement.

## Three positions of the expiry date

| Position against the offer date | Reduction |
|---|---|
| before it | time-barred, 4.0 percentage points |
| on it, or up to 180 calendar days after it | near expiry, 2.0 percentage points |
| more than 180 calendar days after it | none |

## Hypothetical boundary cases

- Expiry date one day before the offer date: 4.0 points.
- Expiry date on the offer date: 2.0 points.
- Expiry date 180 calendar days after the offer date: 2.0 points; 181 days after: none.
